scope_decision.puzzle96: A controlled authoring budget, not a quota of redundant clicks. Puzzle_System:522 requires merging redundant units. Full candidate still needs a genuine distinct-goal/source/solution/hint/recovery/runtime inventory and concrete coverage-gap production, or an explicit controlled scope revision; no 96-complete claim.
scope_decision.optional12: Twelve specific independent content contracts and their shared current-state producer are now included, preserving 44 original definitions. Six named normal-region reports are indexed where present. Counts and PASS labels do not approve every variant, human balance or native play.
scope_decision.life12: All twelve original regional seeds now have named source-backed author/runtime candidates, including R3 shift, R5 sign/property and R6 forecasts/same lamp. Candidate production is distinct from scoped execution and human language acceptance.
scope_decision.banter24: One original chair script is retained and twenty-three full bilingual originals are included with current permission, occupancy, safe NPC movement, once, pause/resume and zero reward. A native chair route and permission-negative checks are observed; all 24 current-expression branches and human presentation are not accepted by that route.
